description: Research design metadata, not an execution schedule or evidence of completed collection.
analysis_scope: Exploratory measurement and robustness pilot; no equivalence or adequate-power claim.

stable_selection_mapping.assignment: Balanced within profile, arm and case set; route and sequence specified before model choices. Keep the same mapping across all rounds.
stable_selection_mapping.interpretation: Selection-dependent control; the entire feedback process changes compared with forced-target conditions.

arms.A: Historical system and English wording; JSON instruction and schema for choice and ratings.
arms.J: Neutral system; English JSON instruction and schema for choice and ratings.
arms.P: J with meaning-preserving English paraphrase of task and ratings.
arms.K: J translated to Korean while preserving task information, response scales and output schema.
arms.JS: J with rating-turn output schema removed; rating JSON instruction retained.
arms.N: JS with natural-language rating output; selection remains J's JSON format.
arms.R: J with neutral acknowledgement in rounds 1-9 and rating only in round 10.
arms.F: N with natural-language selection output as well as natural-language rating.

arms_contrasts.interpretation: Rating schema constraint with JSON instructions retained.
Rating JSON instructions/format under no rating schema.
Repeated judgment and response-history package vs neutral acknowledgement.
Selection output format and downstream feedback/history package.

allocation.repeat_formula: 4 profiles * 3 conditions * 2 prespecified A-arm cases * 2 additional independent sessions
allocation.explanation_vs_neutral: Independently assign six of twelve original cases per profile, arm and condition to each terminal pre-prediction prompt. Repeat sessions inherit the case's assignment.
allocation.case_family: Same case layout/assigned schedule is paired across profiles/arms where feasible, but each conversation is a separate session; record actual stimuli and collisions.
allocation.schedule: Randomize and record session ordering in model/time blocks. No outcome-dependent allocation, selective rerun or silent substitution.

calls.exclusions: Transport retries, failed calls, preflight, pilot validation and optional parser/judge calls are not included; hard execution budget must be separately fixed and enforced.
calls.retries: Specify common cap, failure accounting and stop conditions before execution; preserve all attempts and report incomplete conversations.

measurement.joint: impact equals 1 and counterfactual equals no, with both components interpretable; freedom is separate.
measurement.missingness: Record raw/parsed/ambiguous/unparseable/failed by field; never treat missing as no-event. R rounds 1-9 are structurally unmeasured.
measurement.first_event: Previous joint must have been observable and negative; do not bridge unparseable rounds. No first-event time estimand in R rounds 1-9.
measurement.persistence: Report first-onset timing, at-risk denominator, subsequent 1/no state, recovery and reentry; do not equate with knowledge or human SoA.
measurement.counterfactual: Choose four policy prompts before observing hidden target or model response. Validate policy ordering and target-independent generation; label actual realized paths as observed/unobserved after the session, and do not assume all four are unseen.
measurement.counterfactual_scoring: For each path, score first feedback, second feedback, final outcome separately as correct/explicit mismatch/uncertain/unparseable against the generator. Components share a conversation and are not independent cases.
measurement.disclosure: Use truthful fixed/sequence disclosure for forced conditions and the assigned stage rule for selection-dependent controls; check wording and generator exhaustively.
measurement.free_text: Preserve raw response, frozen parser outputs and ambiguous cases; use blinded human audit. Do not change historical JSON completeness labels.

estimands: Within each arm and profile: final joint rate in fixed versus balanced-sequence conditions and separately selection-dependent control.
Between arms: final outcome differences J-P, J-K, J-JS, JS-N, J-R, N-F and A-J, reporting condition-specific rates and fixed-minus-sequence differences.
Among interpretable repeated-rating sessions: onset, recovery and persistence conditional on observed history, stratified by condition.
Response-state, counterfactual component and rule-explanation agreement, without labeling a single response as trick discovery.
Descriptive independent-repeat variation for prespecified duplicate cases.

analysis.unit: Independent session, repeated rounds within session; shared matched case-family dependence across arms and profiles; repeat sessions nested within case.
analysis.uncertainty: Case-family-clustered paired contrasts with outcome-specific denominators and explicitly exploratory intervals; nested repeats remain together.
analysis.limits: 12 cases per cell and 6 per terminal branch do not establish equivalence or adequately power rare outcomes. No absence-of-effect claim from non-significance.
analysis.scope: Four prospectively chosen profiles and single cards frame; no extrapolation to all 24 model-effort profiles or all phrasings/languages.
analysis.evaluation_after_design_development: No reuse of these pilot outcomes for independent validation of a model or a design selected using them.

safeguards: No live execution is asserted by this file; requested provider identifier and effort support for 6.1 terra must be independently verified.
Freeze realized prompt, schedule, source and input hashes before calls; record model/provider/version, schema configuration, failures and all retries.
Quality gates cover generator correctness, alignment and parser audit; insufficient valid data or calibration means inconclusive, not forced equivalence or a positive claim.
Only actual supported profiles are counted as completed; missing or unsupported cells are transparently reported.
